title: Pilots Need Heroes Too
description:
This piece shows the importance two specific Airmen have in ensuring the safety of Pilots while they fly.  It covers a specific section of Aircraft Maintenance that is responsible for maintaining the ejection systems pilots use as a failsafe in the event of a crash.

Lead: There are hundreds of thoughts flowing through a pilot's mind as they guide their aircraft through the sky. Staff Sgt. Shawn Bryant found a couple of Airmen on the Bagram Flightline who are key players in making sure these pilots have one less thing to worry about.  Soundbites include A1C Mark Armstrong - 455 EAMXS Egress Technician and SrA Garron Theriault - 455 EAMXS Egress Technician.  Produced by SSgt Shawn Bryant. Also available in High Definition.
